mechanism_narrative: A higher level of consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) compresses real equity valuations and increases the risk of monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 250, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4.0 occurs in 10% of observations, but 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises above 255.305 and unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 3.7, it indicates a strong economy with inflationary pressure, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition CPIAUCSL>255.305 AND UNRATE<3.7 occurs in 10% of observations, but 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime defined by GDP growth (GDPC1) above 18910.332 and consumer spending (RSAFS) above 519020.0, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to overvaluation and impending monetary tightening over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition GDPC1>18910.332 AND RSAFS>519020.0 occurs in 10% of observations, but 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher employment levels (PAYEMS) indicate a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above 150000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 occurs in 10% of observations, but 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1260.0 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 109.0, it indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition HOUST<1260.0 AND INDPRO<109.0 occurs in 10% of observations, but 60-day returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 255.305 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2.5%, it indicates a policy misalignment that increases equity volatility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The condition CPIAUCSL>255.305 AND FEDFUNDS<2.5 occurs in 10% of observations, but 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of those instances, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
